description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00099025
Sheriff’s File # 26001228
PLAINTIFF – Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB, as Owner Trustee of the Residential Credit Opportunities Trust IX-A vs:
DEFENDANTS- Crystal Marie Smith, et al;
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 17th day of August, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Keyport, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 27, Block 103 Tax Map of Borough of Keyport
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
67 Jackson Street Keyport, NJ 07735
Occupancy Status: Borrower Occupied
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 125.00ft from the nearest cross street known as Atlantic Street
Approximate Dimensions: 127.03ft x 39.83ft x 125.70ft x 58.19ft
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Deed instrument Number 2023078201
Approximate upset price is $499,034.82 for the Sheriff's Sale
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated May 19, 2026.
Subject to: 2025 Taxes, $9,035.71 Billed; $173.24 Open Plus Penalty; $8,862.47 Paid
2026 1st quarter taxes due 2/1/2026, $2,258.93 Open Plus Penalty
2026 2nd quarter taxes due 5/1/2026, $2,258.93 Open Plus Penalty
2026 3rd quarter taxes due 8/1/2026, to be determined
2026 4th quarter taxes due 11/1/2026, to be determined
Water: Acct. 30030900 0, 12/1/2025-3/1/2026, $100.00 Open Plus Penalty; $556.51 Open Plus Penalty; owed in arrears
Subject to Final Reading
Sewer: Acct. 30030900 0, 12/1/2025-3/1/206, $163.36 Open Plus Penalty; $727.06 Open Plus Penalty; Owed in arrears
Subject to Final Reading
Subject to tax sale. Subject to additional fees
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $491,430.39.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: June 12, 2026
Hill Wallack LLP
21 Roszel Road
P.O. Box 5226
Princeton, NJ 08540
609-924-0808
